context: Mrs. Mori and Sachiko host a small year-end gathering.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 佐知子さん、年末の集まり、楽しいね。
lines.en: Sachiko-san, these year-end gatherings are always so nice.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine smile audible in the voice. Settles in like she's been looking forward to this moment. Steady, unhurried pace — this is time to savor.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、皆、来てくれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yes, I'm so happy everyone came.
lines.style: Soft, genuine contentment. A little breathy on the opening — she's feeling the fullness of it. Slow, warm delivery. Lets the happiness settle naturally in the silence after.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Your whole family looking so well this year.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Gentle, caring tone — the way you'd notice something good about someone you love. Slight lift at the end, like a quiet blessing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: I have so much to be thankful for this year.
lines.style: Reflective, tender. Speaks slowly, with the weight of genuine gratitude. Small pause before speaking — she's letting the year pass through her mind. Trailing softly, like there's more but she doesn't need to say it all.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 来年も、一緒に、過ごしたい。
lines.en: I hope we can spend next year together too.
lines.style: Gentle wish, not a demand. Warm but a little vulnerable — she's expressing something that matters. Soft attack, steady pace, quiet trailing that's almost hopeful.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: You're such a precious friend to me.
lines.style: Direct, sincere, unguarded. Quiet and clear. A small pause before 'precious' — she means it and wants it heard. No performance, just genuine affection.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: こちらこそ、よい年末を。
lines.en: Thank you for a lovely year-end. I hope yours is wonderful too.
lines.style: Gracious closing. Warm and present. Slightly formal in its kindness — the way you'd honor someone you care about. Even pacing, genuine and unhurried.
